rationale: The NEGATIVE half of the artifact_ref $comment, made executable. Document 16 section 14.5 says an ArtifactRef 'carries its semantic role, classification, and rights snapshot', which reads two ways: inline members of the ref, or sibling members of the object that holds it. Only the second validates -- pinned-version-ref:1 sets unevaluatedProperties:false, so the inline reading is refused here while typed-ref-artifact-slot-carries-its-siblings-beside-the-ref accepts the nested one. The $comment used to leave that ambiguous, so a consumer could implement the reading the released schema rejects and find out at integration.
